notes.title: UPDATE: Lock on targetting now available
notes.content:
UPDATE:  The lock-on feature for improved enemy targeting during combat is now available.

Play the FREE demo OUT NOW on Steam, compatible with VR (via Virtual Desktop).

Add Kemet X to your Wishlist on Steam and subscribe to the Patreon—link in bio.
